race.comment: BEWICKED (10) found the top from a wide draw last start at Launceston, and was only bloused out on the line, finishing second by a nose. She has a better draw, peaks third up, and can go one better. ARIANNA'S GOLD (6) is a lightly tried 5YO mare resuming from a spell, and she went close to winning a race last season. A couple of tune-up trials will have her ready to rumble fresh. ROXY DANCER (7) was a beaten favourite on debut, finishing third after showing a stack of talent at the trials. She will be a lot stronger now, and with the aid of the pole position, she will go close to taking this out. Follow your money. GEEGEES LAST WORD (5) finished third on debut in his only start to date as a juvenile. He resumes with a couple of trials under his belt, and should be very competitive. UPHEAVAL (3) cops a tough gate for his return, and was close up in a recent trial. Keep safe.
